4.t: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺

7.t: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass

8.t: So when the stars are put out

9.t: and the sky is torn apart

10.t: and the mountains are blown away

11.t: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—

12.t: for which Day has all this been set

14.t: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is

15.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

16.t: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers

17.t: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them

18.t: This is how We deal with the wicked

19.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

20.t: Did We not create you from a humble fluid

21.t: placing it in a secure place

23.t: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so

24.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

25.t: Have We not made the earth a lodging

26.t: for the living and the dead

27.t: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink
27.tr: Wa-ja'alnaa feehaa rawaasiya shaamikhaatinw Wa-asqainaakum maaa'an furaataa

28.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

29.t: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny
29.tr: Intaliqooo ilaa maa kuntum bihee tukazziboon

30.t: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns
30.tr: Intaliqooo ilaa zillin zee salaasi shu'ab

31.t: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames
31.tr: Laa zaleelinw Wa-laa yughnee minal lahab

32.t: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles

34.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

35.t: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak

36.t: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses

37.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

38.t: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺

39.t: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”

40.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

41.t: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs

43.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
43.tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee-'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

44.t: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers

45.t: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers

46.t: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”

47.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

48.t: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow
48.tr: Wa-izaa qeela lahumur ka'oo laa yarka'oon

49.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers

50.t: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in
